title: AARO historical report misstated Michael Herrera's testimony

tellings.quote: One specific specific example we know for a fact that was lied about in Arrow historical report volume one was Michael Herrera's testimony.

plain: The Pentagon office set up to investigate UFOs, called AARO, published the first volume of its historical report in 2024, and the online researcher known as UAPGerb says it got one witness badly wrong: a man named Michael Herrera. UAPGerb tells Michels that "we know for a fact" Herrera's testimony "was lied about" in that report, pointing to Herrera's own written memorandum of what he said and to Sean Kirkpatrick, who ran the office. If so, the government's official history would be misrepresenting the people who came forward.
